summary: Outside the skyscraper, the Agents lead a handcuffed Neo out of the revolving doors, forcing his head down as they push him into a dark sedan. Trinity, seated on her motorcycle, watches the arrest in the rearview mirror, then curses: "Shit."

what_changes.before: He is being led out of the building handcuffed by the Agents.
what_changes.after: He is forced into the dark sedan, now fully in their custody.
what_changes.evidence: forcing his head down as they push him into the dark sedan.

what_changes.before: She watches the arrest unfold in the rearview mirror of her motorcycle.
what_changes.after: Realizing Neo has been captured, she reacts with a curse.
what_changes.evidence: Trinity watches in the rearview mirror of her motorcycle. TRINITY Shit.

event_hint.one_line: The Agents capture Neo and load him into a car while Trinity witnesses it.

uncertain: Whether Trinity intends to follow the sedan or attempt a rescue.
